name: Let Agents In
summary: Measures whether an AI coding agent can find, register with and integrate a product.
why_no_signup: The scan reads only public pages, so there is nothing to authenticate. An account would be a gate with nothing behind it.

endpoints.name: scan
endpoints.notes: Answers only when the scan is finished, usually in about 10 seconds. Fetching is capped at a 27 second budget, with scoring and storage after it, so allow a minute before timing out. Signup probes run three times because bot gates answer inconsistently.

endpoints.name: mcp
endpoints.request: JSON-RPC 2.0: initialize, tools/list, tools/call with scan_domain
endpoints.response: JSON-RPC 2.0 result, text content plus structuredContent carrying the scorecard
endpoints.notes: Streamable HTTP, no authentication. Same scan and same limits as /api/scan.

endpoints.name: corpus
endpoints.response: Every published scan as data: one row per domain, one entry per check, one formula version. CSV at /corpus.csv
endpoints.notes: No authentication, no rate limit. Free to use and quote with attribution.

refusals: IP literals, private ranges and non-resolving hosts are refused on purpose.
Redirects are re-checked at every hop against the resolved address.
